sections.text: مقدمة

توضح هذه الوثيقة فحص المعدات I1، الذي يجب إجراؤه 
كل ستة أشهر كما هو موضح بواسطة M6 في شريط العنوان أعلاه.

A shaft sealing system is required to seal the turbine casing so that vacuum may 
be established at startup. After startup, sealing must be maintained so that air 
will not leak into sub-atmospheric section of the machine, and excess steam in 
the high-pressure section of the machine does not blow out into the turbine 
room, or into bearing housing to contaminate lubricating oil. At startup, 
Sealing is achieved by introducing steam between intermediate packing rings, and 
venting between outer packing rings to condenser at sub-atmospheric pressure.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abou El-Fetouh Shata & eng. Ismail Abdel Moneim, tested by eng. 
Ali Abd Elslam, revised by EDEPC quality control engineer Abouda Elbana, 
accepted by general director ENG. Yosry Abd Elmaqsood, and approved by eng. Fathy 
Ragab head sector of Talkha Power Station .

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director, and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precaution

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.
Shutdown the unit.

sections.text:
The Steam Regulator out of 
Service
افتح محبس التصريف الموجود على منظمات مرشح إمداد الهواء لإزالة أي مكثفات.

Verify that air supply filter-regulators are holding the supply pressure to 
 the regulator instruments at 35 psig.

Verify that the controller sensing line above the water seal is full of water 
 by removing header pressure gauge. Also verify that needle valve in sensing 
 line is not fully closed.

With the air supply to the controller on push the cleanout wire on the 
 controller relay to clean the relay orifice.
